body: PR #1136 tested PWP-V0-028..030 with fake runners only. Expected: a real Playwright run (Chrome for Testing 154 / Playwright approved 2026-10-17) shows tee output, the runner exit status record, and on --timeout an interrupted report with reporters' onEnd outputs present.
title: Live-qualify PWP-V0-028..030 (runner output tee, exit status, SIGINT-first timeout) against real Playwright
